neighbours.label: a next-token predictor for a business-entity noun (company, firm, maker, manufacturer, conglomerate): the modifier or determiner right before it ('his own construction _', 'a private _', 'the Japanese _', 'mining _'), peak on that word; the same determiners before non-business nouns stay low, but a modifier that itself predicts a firm ('a private detective') fires
fire: She spent a decade at a small software company in Leeds.
The port was sold to a Dutch shipping firm last spring.
Toyota, the Japanese carmaker, reported record profits.
After the merger he founded his own consulting firm.
The patent belongs to a Swiss pharmaceutical company.
The site was cleared by a local construction company.
The route is run by a family-owned bus company.
The parts come from a Taiwanese electronics manufacturer.
quiet: She spent a decade at a small village school in Leeds.
The port was sold to the city council last spring.
The new hybrid sedan sold in record numbers.
After the merger he moved to his own apartment.
The patent describes a new chemical process.
The site was cleared by a crew of local volunteers.
The route is run by a family of retired drivers.
The parts come from a port near Kaohsiung.

predictions: fire items 0.35-0.6 on the word before the company noun; near misses below 0.2 (near misses avoid 'private' and nationality adjectives, which set up the prediction)
notes: Card: ' the' x4, 'es' x4 (Aktieng|es|ellschaft), ' an' x3, ' private' x2, ' a' x2, ' own', ' mining', ' Japanese', 'edish' (turbine company); the + pole promotes ' nonprofit', ' charities', ' NGO'; max 74, density 0.037%.
